page.title: Learner home
page.description: Choose what learners see first when they open the app, and in what order.
page.loadError: Could not load the learner home.
page.notEnabledTitle: Learner home is not switched on
page.notEnabledBody: Ask your Vacademy contact to switch on the Learner home module for this institute.
page.noAccessTitle: Only institute admins can edit the learner home
page.noAccessBody: Ask an admin of this institute if you need a change on the learner home.
page.holisticTitle: This institute keeps its own home page
page.holisticBody: The learner home of this institute is built specially and cannot be changed here.

topbar.discardBody: Your changes since the last publish are deleted. Learners keep seeing the live version.
topbar.reachNote: Changes reach learners within about a minute of publishing.

conflict.title: Someone else saved this draft
conflict.body: Saved by {{name}} at {{time}}. Reload to see their version, or overwrite it with yours.
conflict.bodyUnknown: Reload to see the newer version, or overwrite it with yours.

start.title: Start your learner home
start.subtitle: Pick a starting point. Nothing changes for learners until you publish.
start.editLiveBody: Make a draft copy of version {{version}} and change it. Learners keep seeing the live version until you publish.

CURRENT.title: Start from my current home
CURRENT.body: Brings in today’s home exactly as learners see it now, including your custom cards.

COURSES_ONLY.title: Courses only
COURSES_ONLY.body: For online course sellers: a banner, continue learning, shortcuts and a shelf of new courses.

CLASSROOM.title: Classroom
CLASSROOM.body: For batches and live classes: a must-read notice, live classes and today’s work near the top.

STOREFRONT.title: Storefront
STOREFRONT.body: For selling: a banner, shortcuts and course shelves that hide what each learner already owns.

sample.noticeBody: Please read the term plan and the class rules before your first class.

start.currentFailed: Could not read your current home settings.
start.cardsLeftOut_one: {{count}} custom card does not fit the page limits and is left out.
start.cardsLeftOut_other: {{count}} custom cards do not fit the page limits and are left out.
start.cardsClipped_one: {{count}} custom card is shortened to fit the length limits.
start.cardsClipped_other: {{count}} custom cards are shortened to fit the length limits.

blockTypeHints.BANNER_CAROUSEL: Up to 5 sliding pictures with links
blockTypeHints.SHORTCUTS: A row of icons that open pages or features
blockTypeHints.COURSE_SHELF: A row of courses from a tag, a list or the newest
blockTypeHints.NOTICE: A message card, with an optional “I have read this”
blockTypeHints.EVENT: A date with a countdown and a join button

HERO.name: Hero
HERO.desc: The greeting band with the resume button and the live-class banner.

PINS.name: Pinned announcements
PINS.desc: Announcements you pin to the dashboard.

NOTEBOOK_REVIEW.name: Notebook review
NOTEBOOK_REVIEW.desc: A reminder to review saved notes.

COMPANIONS.name: Study companions
COMPANIONS.desc: The learner’s knowledge-base companions, if any.

TODAY_TASKS.name: Today’s tasks
TODAY_TASKS.desc: Tasks from a daily engagement plan, when one is running.

CONTINUE_LEARNING.name: Continue learning
CONTINUE_LEARNING.desc: Each learner’s own last lessons, with a resume button.

ENROLLED_COURSES.name: Enrolled courses
ENROLLED_COURSES.desc: One card per course the learner is in, with progress.

STATS_ROW.name: Stat cards
STATS_ROW.desc: Counts of courses, live classes and assessments.

LEARNING_ANALYTICS.name: Learning analytics
LEARNING_ANALYTICS.desc: The learner’s study time and progress charts.

MY_MEMBERSHIP.name: My membership
MY_MEMBERSHIP.desc: The learner’s memberships and their expiry.

MY_BOOKS.name: My books
MY_BOOKS.desc: Books the learner has bought or rented.

UPCOMING_LIVE_CLASSES.name: Upcoming live classes
UPCOMING_LIVE_CLASSES.desc: The learner’s next live classes with a join button.

THIS_WEEK_ATTENDANCE.name: Attendance this week
THIS_WEEK_ATTENDANCE.desc: The learner’s attendance for the week.

GET_APP.name: Get the app
GET_APP.desc: Download links for your app, when you have one.

RAISE_QUERY.name: Raise a query
RAISE_QUERY.desc: A card to ask the institute a question, when doubts are on.

EXPLORE_BUTTONS.name: Explore buttons
EXPLORE_BUTTONS.desc: Buttons to browse memberships and books.

list.title: Blocks
list.subtitle: Phones show blocks in this order. Drag to reorder.
list.empty: No blocks yet. Add one to start.

list.funBadge: Not shown in the Fun look

add.allPlaced: Every built-in is already on the page

editor.noSelection: Select a block to edit it.
editor.adminLabelHint: Only you see this name, here and in Results.

banner.title: Heading (optional)
banner.titleHint: Read out by screen readers; not shown on the banner.
banner.autoRotateHint: Learners can pause it. It never slides with one slide or reduced motion.
banner.desktopImageHint: Optional. Used on screens 1024 px and wider.
banner.maxSlides: Up to 5 slides. More than 3 get few clicks.

shortcuts.title: Heading (optional)
shortcuts.label: Label
shortcuts.maxTiles: Up to 16 tiles. Phones show 4 at a time and scroll.

shelf.title: Heading
shelf.noTags: Your courses have no tags yet.
shelf.hideOwned: Hide courses the learner already has
shelf.hideOwnedHint: Each learner sees only courses they can still buy or join.
shelf.seeAllHint: Left empty, it opens the course list (filtered by the first tag for a tag shelf).
shelf.visibilityNote: Shelves show only courses a learner could see in the course catalogue.

notice.title: Heading
notice.bodyHint: Plain text. Line breaks are kept.
notice.requireAck: Ask learners to confirm they read it
notice.requireAckHint: Shows a button; it can be closed only after that. Results lists who read it.

event.title: Heading
event.subtitle: Short line under the heading
event.noSessions: No public live class has a coming schedule.
event.joinOpens: Join button appears this many minutes before the start
event.liveDefaultsNote: Left empty, both buttons open the live class’s registration page.
event.hidesAfterEnd: The block hides itself after the end time.

builtin.gettingStarted: Show the “Let’s get you started” checklist
builtin.showAll: Show every enrolled course, not just the first few
builtin.gateNote: It also follows its own setting, so some learners may not see it.
builtin.funNote: The Fun look leaves this widget out.
builtin.heroRequired: The hero cannot be removed, but you can move it.
builtin.placeholderNote: The preview shows a placeholder: each learner sees their own data.

audience.label: Show to
audience.rules: Learners who match all of these

schedule.zone: Times are in the institute’s time zone ({{zone}}).

where.diagram: Desktop layout: full-width blocks, then a main and a side column

settings.title: Page settings

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: Built-in widgets show placeholders. Content blocks show as the picked learners would see them.

publish.title: Publish learner home
publish.warnings: Worth a look (you can still publish)
publish.noChanges: No changes since the live version.

issues.INVALID_URL: This web address cannot be used.

issues.FEATURE_CONDITIONAL: This page is not on for every learner; some will not see this link.

issues.MANY_SLIDES: {{count}} slides: slides after the third get few clicks.
